description: Weaken the refund-limit comparison so refunds up to ten times the charge are allowed
expected_violation: A refund exceeding the charged amount is accepted instead of rejected
violation_scenario: process_refund(Payment(id='p3', charged_amount=50.0), 50.01) would be accepted, but the existing over-refund tests should catch this.
rationale: Comparing against ten times the charge relaxes the limit, but the existing single and cumulative over-refund tests assert rejection and should kill it.
